alerts.title: EFV CNS toxicity: insomnia and vivid dreams
alerts.message: Guidelines list persistent CNS toxicity including insomnia and abnormal dreams as EFV adverse effects warranting substitution. Patient reports poor sleep and vivid dreams for weeks after 23 months on EFV. EFV is the likely cause given the classic symptom profile and temporal relationship. No alternative explanations are evident in the clinical notes. Guidelines note EFV 400 mg has fewer adverse events than 600 mg, and DTG-based regimens are preferred first-line. The clinician's plan documents symptoms but proposes no regimen change.

evidence.recommended_action: Substitute EFV with DTG (transition to TLD) or reduce EFV dose to 400 mg if available, per guideline toxicity management recommendations.

alerts.title: Missing renal and liver function monitoring on TDF
alerts.message: Guidelines recommend routine viral load monitoring at 12-month intervals for adults on ART. The last viral load was 165 days ago, so it is not yet overdue. However, no renal function tests or liver function tests are documented despite TDF guidelines advising LFTs and RFTs to monitor for nephrotoxicity, Fanconi syndrome, and hepatotoxicity. The clinician's plan today includes no lab orders.

evidence.recommended_action: Verify and order baseline and periodic RFTs and LFTs for TDF safety monitoring. Continue annual viral load per schedule.
